$schema_doc: Built-in seeds. Auto-seeding creates missing models only. `/memory mm seed` upgrades built-ins capped at 600/800 tokens to the configured budget. Tags MUST match retained tags; otherwise `all_strict` refreshes empty. Keep source queries here for review. `max_tokens` bounds server reflect generation; the render budget bounds prompt injection.

seeds.name: User Preferences
seeds.source_query: What does the user prefer in coding style, tooling, communication, and review? Capture only durable preferences expressed across sessions, not one-off requests.

seeds.name: Project Conventions
seeds.source_query: What are this project's conventions for code style, build, testing, release, and pull-request review? Only include conventions that are explicit in the project (settings, scripts, contributor docs, repeatedly enforced in review).

seeds.name: Project Decisions
seeds.source_query: What durable architectural or product decisions have been made for this project, and what rationale or trade-offs were recorded? Include only decisions that are stable across sessions; exclude transient plans, unresolved ideas, and active task state.
